parsed.reason: Description A says the fixed metadata temp filename `.<name>.meta.tmp` causes concurrent puts to the same key to race, so one os.replace raises FileNotFoundError. Description B says the mutable default argument `metadata={}` is shared across calls, so setdefault leaks content-type between uploads. These are different failures (a concurrency race on temp files versus a shared mutable default dict) at different lines of the code.
